title: A Childhood Memory
summary: A narrator recalls summers at a grandmother's house in the interior.

paragraphs.pt: Quando eu era criança, passava quase todas as férias na casa da minha avó, no interior de Goiás. A casa era simples, com quintal grande, mangueira antiga e uma varanda onde todo mundo se reunia no fim da tarde.
paragraphs.en: When I was a child, I spent almost every vacation at my grandmother's house, in the interior of Goiás. The house was simple, with a large yard, an old mango tree, and a porch where everyone gathered in the late afternoon.

paragraphs.pt: Minha avó acordava cedo e preparava bolo de milho. Eu ajudava a buscar ovos no galinheiro, embora tivesse um pouco de medo das galinhas. Depois do almoço, meus primos e eu inventávamos jogos com pedras, folhas e caixas vazias.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother woke up early and made corn cake. I helped collect eggs in the chicken coop, although I was a little afraid of the chickens. After lunch, my cousins and I invented games with stones, leaves, and empty boxes.

paragraphs.pt: Hoje, quando sinto cheiro de bolo quente, lembro daquela casa. Muita coisa mudou, mas a lembrança continua viva: o barulho dos insetos, a voz da minha avó e a sensação de que o tempo passava devagar.
paragraphs.en: Today, when I smell warm cake, I remember that house. Many things have changed, but the memory remains alive: the sound of insects, my grandmother's voice, and the feeling that time passed slowly.

comprehension.question: Where did the narrator spend vacations?
options: At the grandmother's house in Goiás
